sender.sr: „Centralna banka Crne Gore“, „Western Union“ ili druga poznata institucija
sender.en: “Central Bank of Montenegro”, “Western Union” or another well-known institution

name.sr: Lažni poklon od institucije: „svaki građanin dobija 50 eura, preuzmite preko linka“
name.en: Fake gift from an institution: “every citizen gets 50 euros, claim it through the link”

how.sr: Preko aplikacija za poruke i društvenih mreža kruži poruka da Centralna banka, zajedno sa poznatom firmom, svakom punoljetnom građaninu daje jednokratni poklon od 50 eura. Za preuzimanje treba otvoriti link i popuniti podatke. Link vodi na fišing stranicu koja krade lične i bankovne podatke. Poruku obično prosljeđuju poznanici koji su joj povjerovali.
how.en: A message circulates on messaging apps and social media saying the Central Bank, together with a well-known company, is giving every adult citizen a one-off gift of 50 euros. To claim it you open a link and fill in your details. The link leads to a phishing page that steals personal and banking details. The message is usually forwarded by acquaintances who believed it.

text.sr: Poruka da institucija dijeli novac svim građanima.
text.en: A message saying an institution is handing out money to all citizens.

text.sr: Link za preuzimanje i forma za podatke kartice.
text.en: A claim link and a form for card details.

text.sr: CBCG i Western Union: Svaki punoljetni gradjanin Crne Gore ima pravo na jednokratnu pomoc od 50 EUR. Isplata traje jos samo danas. Preuzmite svoj iznos ovdje: [link] Proslijedite porodici i prijateljima!
text.en: CBCG and Western Union: Every adult citizen of Montenegro is entitled to a one-off payment of 50 EUR. The payout only runs today. Claim your amount here: [link] Forward to family and friends!

sr: upiši podatke lične karte za isplatu
en: one-off payment claim through a link
western union payout to all citizens
state pays every citizen a one-off sum

sr: Centralna banka ne dijeli poklone i ne traži da kliknete link ili popunite formu.
Institucije ne prave zajedničke akcije sa privatnim firmama preko poruka.
Molba da proslijedite poruku služi da se prevara brže širi.
en: The Central Bank doesn’t give gifts or ask you to click a link or fill in a form.
Institutions don’t run joint promotions with private companies via messages.
The request to forward the message is there to spread the scam faster.

sr: Ne otvarajte link i ne prosljeđujte poruku.
Odmah se javite svojoj banci na broj sa kartice ili iz aplikacije i tražite blokadu kartice ako ste upisali njene podatke.
Lažnu poruku i link prijavite Nacionalnom CIRT-u, a ako ste izgubili novac, i policiji na 122.
en: Don’t open the link and don’t forward the message.
Call your bank straight away on the number on your card or in the app and ask for the card to be blocked if you entered its details.
Report the fake message and link to the National CIRT and, if you lost money, to the police on 122.

sources.title: CBCG upozorava na prevaru: Građanima stižu lažne poruke o isplati 50 eura
